# polite-crawler

> polite-crawler is a TypeScript web crawler for research and for AI agents, on npm as `polite-crawler` (Node.js 22.13 or later). It fetches a source one time, keeps the response in a capture log and a content-addressed blob store, and answers later questions from a local SQLite FTS5 index with no new request. It obeys robots.txt (RFC 9309, and the rules for Claude-User when an assistant asks), keeps one request in progress for each host, obeys Retry-After, and stops at a challenge, a 402 or a 403.

Use `openCrawler({ dir })` and its methods `fetch(url, { maxAge, render })`, `find(q)`, `read(doc, { from, length })`, `verify(doc, quote)` and `reindex()`. A command line (`npx polite-crawler fetch|find|read|verify|reindex|mcp`) and an MCP server (`npx -y polite-crawler mcp`) with the tools `crawl_fetch`, `crawl_find`, `crawl_read` and `crawl_verify` use the same store. Pages that need JavaScript use the optional peer `playwright-core`.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/guide/quick-start/): install, the command line, the library
- [Use it from Claude](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/guide/mcp/): the MCP server and its four tools
- [How it works](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/guide/how-it-works/): the path of a request, the store, capture ids, recipes
- [How the crawler is polite](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/guide/politeness/): rests, refusals, the User-Agent, content signals
- [Library API](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/reference/api/): each option, method and part
- [Command line](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/reference/cli/): each command and option
- [About PoliteCrawler](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/bot/): for site owners, how to slow or block the crawler

## Tools

- [robots.txt tester](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/tools/robots-txt-tester/): which rule permits or refuses a path, for each user agent
- [What the crawler sees](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/tools/page-reader/): JSON-LD, visible text, links and the JavaScript decision for pasted HTML
- [Opening-hours parser](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/tools/opening-hours/): the week that page text, schema.org or OpenStreetMap hours give

## Optional

- [What 300 restaurant websites taught a crawler](https://mark1russell7.github.io/crawler/notes/restaurant-websites/): a survey
